payload.title: M1: Meta app and Page connect proven for real (#1)
payload.objective: Prove against the real Graph API that an owner can create a Meta app without review, connect Pages they manage and hold Page tokens. Originally planned as throwaway spike scripts; done by real use on the home server on 2026-11-26 instead. Publishing and visibility moved to the goal 'First real publish and visibility check'.
successCriteria: A Meta app with the use case Manage everything on your Page exists and needs no review for its own role users
Connect returns Page tokens with pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement and pages_manage_posts
Pages held in a business portfolio connect once business_management is requested
No token or secret is committed, printed or logged
